$comment: GENERATED from hadron-cli internal/skilldoc by the #1177 fixture generator. The hash / render / renderParseRoundTrip sections were REGENERATED at 1d8ca46 for #1235 (§4a: the node id leads the hash), which changed EVERY digest in them — an empty id hashes as the empty string rather than being skipped, so pre-§4a inputs move too. The id-bearing cases added there are the ones the old fixture could not express, and render + renderParseRoundTrip are kept NAME-ALIGNED because the round-trip test looks its inputs up in render by case name. renderParseRoundTrip records what Go READ BACK off its own rendered file, so its content is post-NormalizeBody. Sections not listed still date from 973cd1f and are untouched by §4a. Language-neutral: the Go and TypeScript suites both load this file, so a port that diverges reds rather than passing its own restatement of itself. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.  D12 (2026-09-19) retired name derivation and the org prefix, so the deriveName and validPrefix sections were removed; validName survives and now validates a STORED name.  The `lint` and `lintCollisions` sections were generated later, at 1a8036b (recorded separately as lintSourceCommit): the earlier sections predate D12, and regenerating them wholesale would have mixed a re-measurement into a port. Both commits are on main; neither section has been hand-edited.
